answer_text:
Connecting support to your CRM means agents see deal and account context on every ticket. Options that do this well:

1. Brightdesk Helpdesk - strong reporting and automations, though the interface feels dated.
2. Calmline - a calm, fast shared inbox with collision detection and CRM sidebars.
3. Northwind CRM - its service module links tickets to accounts, at enterprise prices.

If support is your main workflow, go with Brightdesk; otherwise Calmline keeps things simpler.
